_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. exactly.ai's declared design layer is the 27 --token-* colour names its Framer stylesheets put on <body> (raw/css-vars.json); everything else is measured computed style (raw/components-computed.json). One light theme: the site paints light on every signed-out surface, and its single prefers-color-scheme media rule repaints nothing. Leaves either name a variable ('var', resolved in light) or carry a measured value with its source ('value' + 'source').
